speaker: bulletin
text: PAGASA has raised a red rainfall warning for the province. Torrential rain, more than thirty millimetres an hour, getting heavier over the next three hours. Serious flooding is expected in low-lying areas near rivers and creeks.

speaker: lito
text: Kap, you hear that? Red warning. And the creek sensor has been climbing all afternoon. Slow, but it never stops.

speaker: lito
text: The laptop is on. Look at what the forecast is saying.

speaker: lito
text: The forecast is still loading its history, Kap. Give it a moment and check again.

speaker: lito
text: Good, that is out. People will start packing their go-bags.

speaker: lito
text: Two things, Kap. The mats for the evacuation center are still rolled up in the corner. And at the sari-sari store they say the sensor is broken.

speaker: lito
text: Can you check it against the staff gauge down at the creek? People will believe their own eyes.

speaker: lito
text: Salamat, Kap. I will set up the registration table by the door.

speaker: jun
text: Kap, this is Jun at the bridge! The creek is over the bank. Water is on the road by the bridge!

speaker: radio
text: Sound the siren, Kap! The switch is by the hall door, or use the dashboard.

speaker: radio
text: And remember: Mang Ben across the creek never leaves, and Lola Cora lives alone by the river at the west end.

speaker: jun
text: Kap, Aling Nena is here. Her boy Toto is missing! Someone saw him by the canal near the main road, watching the water.

speaker: radio
text: Siren is up! People are coming out with their bags.

speaker: ben
text: Kap, there is no flood. I have lived here forty years. I will watch the water myself.

speaker: ben
text: Kap! I told you, the water never reaches this house!

speaker: ben
text: ...Within the hour? Sige, sige. Get the kids, we are going. Salamat, Kap.

speaker: ben
text: We are packing, Kap! Two minutes!

speaker: lola
text: Ay, Kap. Is it bad already? Come back for me if it gets worse, ha?

speaker: lola
text: Ay, Kap... the water is at my steps. My knees... I can't run anymore.

speaker: lola
text: You have a good heart, anak. Do not let go of me.

speaker: lola
text: Salamat, anak. God bless you. God bless you.

speaker: toto
text: Kap! Look how high the water is! It is like a river now!

speaker: toto
text: Opo, Kap! Sorry po!

speaker: nena
text: Toto! Anak, where did you go?! Salamat, Kap. Salamat po.

speaker: jun
text: Kap, the main road is going under! It is up to my knees here!

speaker: radio
text: Kap, get everyone inside and come back to the hall. We need the headcount for the MDRRMO.

speaker: radio
text: No siren yet, so people are leaving on their own. Some are wading. Hurry, Kap!

speaker: radio
text: Kap, the list matches. Everyone is inside. Come in and we will call it in.

speaker: lito
text: Twenty-three residents, all accounted for. Calling the MDRRMO now.

speaker: lito
text: MDRRMO, this is Barangay San Roque. Everyone is in the evacuation center. Water at the sensor is over four metres and holding.

speaker: lito
text: Rest, Kap. You did good tonight.

speaker: lito
text: Check your phone, Kap. Everything the sensor sees is on the dashboard, with the forecast.

speaker: lito
text: That is the Bantay Baha forecast, Kap. It takes PAGASA's rain outlook and how fast the creek has been rising, and looks an hour ahead.

speaker: lito
text: The sirens have not even gone off yet. If we move now, we move before the water does. Send an early advisory.

speaker: lito
text: Kap, the forecast now expects the WARNING level in about 5 minutes.

text: Good day! The creek is calm today.
